extraction.notes: Centerspace (CSR) reports no AFFO; core_total is Core FFO, so AFFO fields are null. Three-month column (9/30/2024) used. FFO and Core FFO reconcile to printed subtotals. Diluted per-share figures check: 18,877/18,676 = $1.01 and 22,129/18,676 = $1.18 (diluted subtotals add back $160 Series D preferred dividends, which are not part of the FFO-to-Core FFO adjustments). Interest rate swap amortization was classified as debt_cost_amortization (judgment call). Redemption of preferred shares and 'Other miscellaneous items' (gain on investments and one-time professional fees) were classified as 'other'. recurring_capex_disclosed uses the same-store per-home figure ($347) from the Portfolio Summary, which is per-home in dollars, not a company total, so the amount is not in thousands. The starting_line amount is net loss available to common shareholders.
